overview.summary:
This plan keeps BUG-002 and BUG-003 as two independent vertical defect slices that can execute in parallel in a single wave. S01 restores due-date persistence through the existing edit flow, while S02 restores the documented default priority for quick-add todos without depending on S01.

The PRD's conflict-free merge constraint is stronger than the absolute smallest patch size, so the plan biases toward non-overlapping ownership. Each story owns its own regression surface and avoids opportunistic dialog or template cleanup unless the story's defect cannot be resolved server-side.

sharedDecisions.title: Bias toward merge-isolated ownership
sharedDecisions.description: To satisfy the PRD's conflict-free merge constraint, S01 owns the due-date edit/update path while S02 owns the model-level default-priority source of truth and separate regression coverage, even where a smaller shared-file edit would be possible.

sharedDecisions.title: Preserve the existing HTMX partial contract
sharedDecisions.description: Both stories keep the current server-rendered partial flow intact and avoid dialog JavaScript or template edits unless a server-side fix cannot satisfy the defect.

bindingConstraints.verbatim: Keep each story isolated to its own files; they must merge without conflict.

stories.name: BUG-002 due date persistence in edit flow
stories.scope: Restore due-date persistence for todos edited through the existing dialog so a saved date remains stored, rendered back into the todo row, and available when the dialog is reopened. Includes the edit submission path and rendered todo fragment for that path; excludes due-date styling corrections and any changes to quick-add or priority behavior.
stories.notes: Own the update-path change plus a dedicated due-date regression file so this story does not need to share quick-add or priority edit surfaces.

stories.name: BUG-003 quick-add default priority
stories.scope: Ensure todos created from the quick-add field receive the documented default priority so the created row and the later edit dialog show a valid default selection. Includes the quick-add creation path and regression coverage for default-priority behavior; excludes due-date parsing and broader todo-editor cleanup.
stories.notes: Prefer the model-level default-priority source of truth plus a dedicated regression file so this story can merge cleanly alongside the due-date fix.

riskSummary.mitigation: Prove that a YYYY-MM-DD value persists in storage and round-trips through the rendered todo fragment without widening into unrelated dialog cleanup.

Anchor the default at the model-level source of truth and add quick-add regression coverage that proves the created row and first edit-dialog open both resolve to low priority without shared-file edits.

executionNotes: Execute S01 and S02 in parallel. Preserve the PRD's merge-isolation constraint by keeping regression coverage in story-owned test files and by avoiding opportunistic edits to shared dialog or template code unless a story cannot be completed server-side.
